history.name: WebSurfer
history.content:
Quick reference on common public library status conventions:
- Available: On shelf.
- Checked Out / On Loan: Not on shelf.
- In Transit: Moving between locations; not on shelf.
- On Hold: Reserved for pickup; usually kept off general shelves.
- Processing / In Processing: Being cataloged or repaired; not on shelf.
- Missing/Lost: Not on shelf.
These align with Assistant’s proposed definition.
